lead_raw_text:
The structure of K4Cr2O8 (reduced formula K2CrO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Cr centers coordinated by six O neighbors and K centers with eight O neighbors, while O adopts square-pyramidal coordination. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-sharing between square-pyramidal O polyhedra and both corner- and edge-sharing between Cr octahedra.
